questions.q: Which bones protect the heart and lungs?
questions.why: The ribs form a cage around the heart and lungs.
Tendons join muscle to bone; ligaments join bone to bone.

questions.q: A footballer straightens the knee to kick. What is this movement?
questions.why: Extension increases the angle at the joint.

questions.q: State two functions of the skeleton, each with a sporting example.
questions.model: Protection: the cranium protects the brain when a cyclist falls. Movement: bones act as levers so a footballer can kick a ball.
points: function named (e.g. protection, support, movement, blood cell production, mineral storage)
linked to a correct sporting example
